message: This statement could not be analyzed: SQL is built in a helper the tool cannot follow. It runs only on some code paths (inside a condition, loop, or callback).
why: orm-preflight never passes what it could not read. The statement may contain any of the hazards the other rules check.
safeAlternative: Write the SQL as a constant string or a builder call orm-preflight can read, or check the statement by hand and suppress this finding with a reason.
